name: date-picker
title: DatePicker
summary: Input + popover-calendar composite. Built on Combobox-style trigger (Input visual) + Calendar in a Popover. Single date or range. date-fns for formatting.
description: Input + popover-calendar composite for single date or range.
skillDescription: Use for date entry in forms — pickup, delivery, billing cycle. Composes the v0.6 field-shell input visual with a Calendar popover. For inline calendar use @lumen/calendar. For range use mode='range'.
useWhen: Date entry in forms — pickup, delivery, billing cycle.
When the calendar should appear in a popover, not inline.
api: `format` — date-fns format string (default: 'PP' / 'PP – PP' for range).
never: NEVER use a native <input type='date'> (different per-browser visual).
NEVER omit the calendar icon (it's the affordance).
a11yRules: Format the date in aria-label for screen readers.
